issue.title: Bug: CONSOLE_TELNET wont be "console_telnet" based on master branch

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

**[description]**
sonic-mgmt defines CONSOLE_TELNET = "console_telnet" from
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/common/connections/base_console_conn.py#L22

however, no matter how configs on {console_type} or {console_menu_type}.
it always has an additional underline as "console_telnet_telnet" or "console_telnet_" <- if console_menu_type is null.

    console_type = f"console_{console_type}"
    console_menu_type = f"{console_type}_{console_menu_type}"

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/common/helpers/dut_utils.py#L438
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/common/connections/console_host.py#L25

Case1: if console_type=telnet and console_menu_type=telnet; result is as console_telnet_telnet.
Case2: if console_type=n/a and console_menu_type=telnet; result is as console__telnet.
Case3: if console_type=telnet and console_menu_type=n/a; result is as console_telnet_.
Case4: if console_type=n/a and console_menu_type=n/a; result is as console__.

ERR log:
<IPV6> dut_utils.create_duthost_console         L0459 WARNING| Issue trying to clear console port: console type console_telnet_telnet is not supported yet
<IPV6> dut_utils.create_duthost_console         L0475 WARNING| Attempt 1/3 failed: [Errno 111] Connection refused
<IPV6> dut_utils.create_duthost_console         L0475 WARNING| Attempt 2/3 failed: [Errno 111] Connection refused
<IPV6> dut_utils.create_duthost_console         L0475 WARNING| Attempt 3/3 failed: [Errno 111] Connection refused

**[example]**
sonic@sonic-ucs-m5-4:/data$ cat ./ansible/files/sonic_lab_console_links.csv

StartDevice,StartPort,EndDevice,Console_type,Console_menu_type,Proxy,BaudRate

....
**console-vt2,2003,sfd-vt2-sup,telnet,telnet,<vendor>,115200**
sonic@sonic-ucs-m5-4:/data$

[MY TC]
31/01/2026 <IPV6> test_mgmt_flap_upst.step1_setup_console_ L0158 INFO   | MGMT_FLAP_SINGLE_CONSOLE - STEP 1: Setting up console connection and verifying CLI tool
31/01/2026 <IPV6> test_mgmt_flap_upst.step1_setup_console_ L0165 INFO   | MGMT_FLAP_SINGLE_CONSOLE - Console info for sfd-vt2-sup: {'Hostname': 'console-vt2', 'ManagementIp': '[<IP>](https://<IP>/)', 'HwSku': '<vendor>-RP', 'Type': 'DevSonic', 'Protocol': 'ssh', 'Os': 'sonic', 'null': [''], 'CardType': 'Linecard', 'HwSkuType': 'predefined', 'ManagementRoutes': [], 'ManagementRoutesV6': []}

### Steps to Reproduce

any testcase call below
def create_duthost_console(duthost, localhost, conn_graph_facts, creds)

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/common/connections/console_host.py#L47
can not find the mapping console

resolution.description:
### Description of PR
[component/folder touched]

Fixes #22218
Fixes console_telnet
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/22218

**Info**
when calling create_duthost_console, the current logic wont be as CONSOLE_TELNET = "console_telnet"

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/common/helpers/dut_utils.py#L438
current logic, CONSOLE_TELNET will be "console_telnet_telnet"
wont be CONSOLE_TELNET = "console_telnet"

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/common/connections/base_console_conn.py#L22
CONSOLE_TELNET = "console_telnet"
CONSOLE_SSH = "console_ssh"
